data.narrative:
Strata Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Eric Zhou and Alex Mason that has raised $5.2M to date. The broader Robotics & Manufacturing sector includes one public comparable (277810.KQ) and eight private peers, among them Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $5.2M total raised, yielding a $13M implied valuation. This method is appropriate given the company's position and capital base. Peer-median triangulation is not applicable: while ten same-sector peers exist, fewer than three qualify within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), making a meaningful peer comparison unreliable. Reliance on all-sector medians would introduce material distortion.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $15M, with a median point of $13M. This range reflects a single applicable methodology and should be weighted accordingly. Key uncertainties include the absence of a robust near-peer dataset to validate stage-typical valuations within Robotics & Manufacturing, and the limited maturity of comparable transactions at this stage. Any final valuation should incorporate qualitative assessment of product-market fit, technical defensibility, and founder experience alongside this quantitative framework.
